summary:
Fixed and verified. ✅

**The needle:** an off-by-one bug in the pagination offset in `app/app.py:28`:

```python
offset = (page - 1) * per_page - (1 if page > 1 else 0)   # buggy
offset = (page - 1) * per_page                            # fixed
```

The spurious `- (1 if page > 1 else 0)` shifted every page after the first back by one index, causing the last item of page N to be duplicated as the first item of page N+1 (e.g. page 1 ended at ID 10, page 2 started at ID 10 instead of 11). Removing it makes page boundaries contiguous — `test.sh` now reports **PASS**.
